Subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well — I’m Emily from Acme’s vendor security team. We’re finalizing our procurement checklist for a POC and need a copy of Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report for vendor review. A couple quick asks: 

- Can you confirm the audit period covered by your most recent Type II? Our security reviewers specifically want the period and whether there’s a bridge letter available that covers the gap until the report is published.
- What’s the recommended secure transfer method for the report and any supporting artifacts (SFTP, SharePoint link, or portal)?
- If you have a short reply template we can include in our procurement packet, that would speed things up.

We have a tight timeline — review needs to be completed by Dec 22. Happy to sign an NDA if needed.

Thanks —
Emily Ramos

Acme Corp

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Emily — thanks for reaching out and for the timeline. Quick answers up front, followed by a short intake + templates you can drop into your packet.

Audit period and bridge letter
- Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period Nov 1, 2025 – Oct 31, 2026.
- We can provide a one-page bridge letter that confirms no material control changes since the report period and will be valid until the next report is issued. I’ve attached a draft bridge letter for your review.

Secure transfer options
- Preferred: Secure Drive link with expiry + access logging (we’ll share a Drive link with Viewer + download disabled if requested).
- Alternatives: SFTP drop (technical handoff), or a secure portal link (by request).
- We avoid emailing PDF reports to external addresses without a secure link.

What to share (recommended minimal package)
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- One-page bridge letter (PDF)
- Ask matrix (mapping of report sections to common procurement questions) — I attached the ask matrix (SOC2_TypeII_Ask_Matrix_v1.xlsx).
- Evidence index (list of artifact names and short descriptions) — we can share a filtered set on request.

Short reply templates (copy-paste friendly)
1) Procurement template (public-facing)
"Dear Procurement Team,

Redwood Inference can provide our SOC 2 Type II report covering Nov 1, 2025 – Oct 31, 2026, plus a one-page bridge letter for interim assurance. We prefer to deliver these artifacts via a secure link (recommended) or SFTP. Please let me know your preferred transfer method and any required access controls.

Best,
[Vendor Security Contact]
"

2) Technical/engineering template (if they ask for evidence)
"Hi — we can provide a scoped evidence index and selective artifacts via secure file drop once an MFA-enabled account is provisioned. Reach out to naomi.feldman@redwood.com to coordinate.
"

Attachments included: SOC2_TypeII_Ask_Matrix_v1.xlsx, Redwood_Bridge_Letter_draft.pdf, Evidence_Share_Instructions.txt

If that works, I’ll also loop in Legal for a quick sign-off on the bridge letter (standard practice).

–Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.com
